svg.text: A Dataset is a bundle of labelled arrays with units

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: (xarray). It is the only thing that travels along a wire,

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: so every output can be cached, exported and previewed.
